blockers.name: S4LoopInv.worldSetsDistinct preservation under modalStepBranchS4
blockers.summary: worldSetsDistinct is not, as currently designed, an actual per-step loop invariant of modalStepBranchS4. Two independent gaps: (1) persistent rule firings (K boxPos, T self-propagation, the 4-rule's box-itself propagation) add formulas to an already-known world's relevant set without re-checking distinctness against other known worlds -- the plan's own anticipated hard sub-goal, confirmed real on inspection; (2) the minting guard (blockingWorld) checks the SOURCE world's uniqueness against existing worlds, not the freshly-minted world's own prospective content, so a new world is not guaranteed distinct from existing ones at the moment of creation. Full detail in plans/01_s4-loopchecking-termination-decidability.md under Phase 8's BLOCKER note.
blockers.recommended_scope: Redesign the minting guard (check prospective new-world content, not just source) and/or restate S4LoopInv over a saturation-stable notion; then worldSetsDistinct preservation, the pigeonhole bound, and modalStepBranchS4_worldBound.
